question: According to the passage, what has Middle Eastern and Central Asian influenced in India?
solution:
The correct answer is "**North Indian cuisine.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The line 3 in para 1 of the passage mentions that:
 
 
• **Middle Eastern and Central Asian influences can be seen in North Indian cuisine.**
 
 
 
• The Mughals, who were of Central Asian origin, played a significant role in introducing these flavors to Indian cuisine.
 
• The fusion of these culinary traditions has resulted in the rich and diverse cuisine that is enjoyed in India today.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
